props.description: Disables the primary action button. Cancel stays enabled.

props.name: isAutomaticallyCloseOnActionEnabled

props.description: Surfaces the primary button's pending state (`isPending` — `data-pending` and disabled interaction, per Button).

props.name: onAction
props.description: Primary button click. Closing is the caller's job unless `isAutomaticallyCloseOnActionEnabled` is set.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Cancel button click. The cancel button always closes via `Dialog.Close`.

props.description: Drives the action-button variant and the fallback icon.
